adult-programming-operator.display: Mid-Market Aquarium — Active Adult Programming Operator
intent_signals: aquarium after dark / 21+ / night dive / glow nights program announcement (last 6 months)
new Executive Director or Director of Marketing hire (LinkedIn role-change, last 6 months)
ticket-on-sale announcement for 21+ after-hours event ($39.95–$59.99 range)
sponsor-title announcement for existing adult or holiday program
exclusions: Georgia Aquarium (Atlanta, GA) — enterprise flagship, architectural-lighting-design-firm incumbent
Monterey Bay Aquarium (Monterey, CA) — enterprise flagship
New England Aquarium (Boston, MA) — enterprise flagship
Seattle Aquarium (Seattle, WA) — enterprise flagship, post-2024 Ocean Pavilion capital cycle
Aquariums with no adult-programming history (greenfield — too much market-creation lift for Offer 1)

corporate-sponsor-pipeline.display: Mid-Market Aquarium — Mature Corporate Sponsor Pipeline
intent_signals: named title-sponsor announcement for seasonal or adult program (last 6 months)
city or CVB co-funding relationship mentioned in press release or annual report
Director of Corporate Partnerships role-change or open hire (last 6 months)
sponsor-renewal announcement or 'presenting sponsor' credit in program PR
exclusions: Enterprise flagships (Georgia, Monterey Bay, Shedd, New England, Seattle aquariums)
Aquariums with no Director of Corporate Partnerships function (sponsor-pipeline too immature — 6–9 month close cycle requires existing pipeline infrastructure)
Aquariums with no published economic-impact study and no CVB relationship
